rationale_before_launch: Max4 repeated negative at both caches; max2 could reduce proposal rejection/verification overhead. Director authorized testing unchanged2890 first and no open sweep.
decision: Stop after retained n1exploratory negative. Earliest E1 exceeds both controls and cannot satisfy every-candidate-below-every-control by adding favorable repeats; Director approved noE2/no reduced-max2 arm. This is not repeated max2 proof or universal inferiority.
positive_observation: Acceptance improves versusmax4 and observed serial median is50.772ms lower than pooledoff, but n1serialp95 is15.890ms worse and primarypairmedian/p95 are worse.
